An [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomian]] '''''gruu'' pipe'''<ref name="Special Edition Limited" /> was a sweet-smelling device<ref name="Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> [[Smoking/Legends|smoked]] to heighten awareness.<ref name="Special Edition Limited" /> During his travels, the [[Sarkan/Legends|Sarkan]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] [[Melas/Legends|Melas]] developed a fondness for smoking a ''gruu'' [[Pipe/Legends|pipe]], and only rarely was he seen without it.<ref name="Special Edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''gruu'' pipe was originally created for the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] re-release of the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> It was first identified in ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sourcebook written by [[George R. Strayton]], [[Paul Sudlow]], and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''<ref name="Special Edition" /> and released in [[October]] 1997.<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition release date">{{CollectorCite|1|Playing A Major Role}}</ref>
